## New

Added the "Leaderboard of Leaderboards" or "overall". Points calculated are based upon leaderboard position on other leaderboards on the site!

For now, all leaderboards are worth the same amount of points.

    Score Calculation based upon Leaderboard Positions:
    1st: 40
    2nd: 20
    3rd: 13
    4th: 11
    5th: 9
    6th: 8
    7th: 7
    8th: 6
    9th: 5
    10th: 4

Due to number of calculations and queries this needed, it will be updated instead once every 12 hours instead of insta-live from the database like every other leaderboard.

Check it out here: https://idleonleaderboards.com/overall
